contracts.description: Distance file gardiens : Papeete 16 000 km ne doit pas annuler la publication

checks.name: distance_km_precision
checks.sql: SELECT (numeric_precision = 8 AND numeric_scale = 2) AS ok FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'sitter_digest_queue' AND column_name = 'distance_km'

checks.name: publication_trigger_present
checks.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'public.sits'::regclass AND tgname = 'trg_notify_sitters_on_new_sit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AS ok

contracts.description: Préférences de relance accessibles aux seuls administrateurs pour les propriétaires de brouillons

checks.name: draft_preferences_rpc_exists
checks.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname='admin_draft_email_preferences' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)='p_owner_ids uuid[]' AND p.prosecdef AND p.provolatile='s' AND p.proconfig @> ARRAY['search_path=public, pg_temp']) AS ok

checks.name: draft_preferences_rpc_permissions
checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(has_function_privilege('authenticated', to_regprocedure('public.admin_draft_email_preferences(uuid[])'), 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('anon', to_regprocedure('public.admin_draft_email_preferences(uuid[])'), 'EXECUTE'), false) AS ok

checks.name: draft_preferences_admin_guard
checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT position('has_role(auth.uid()' in pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) > 0 AND position('cardinality(p_owner_ids) > 500' in pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) > 0 AND position('s.published_at IS NULL' in pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) > 0 FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid=to_regprocedure('public.admin_draft_email_preferences(uuid[])')),false) AS ok
